text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a stepped regional routing shift (EU -> APAC) tonight at 00:30 UTC. Objective: move steady traffic for a single model pool to APAC region to validate latency gains. TL;DR plan below, please ack and flag conflicts.

alex: Plan: 1) Preflight: lower DNS TTL to 30s at 00:10 UTC 2) Start 00:30 UTC: route-orchestrator stepper to nudge weights 5% -> 50% over 30m (5% every 3m) 3) Smoke checks after each step: health/p95 latency, 5xx/429s, tail latency, and canary queries 4) If any step breaches thresholds, immediate rollback to previous weight and TTL restore.

alex: Quick commands (ops):
```
# lower TTL
curl -X POST https://infra.internal/api/dns/ttl -d '{"zone":"redwood.example","ttl":30}'

# stepper trigger
route-orchestrator start --policy eu-to-apac-2026-03 --step-size 5 --step-interval 180
```

priya: SGTM. I'll own the TTL change and monitor DNS propagation. I'll have Grafana up for the rollout board and latency panels.

mike: I'll be on the route stepper and watch infra metrics (CPU on gateway pods, connection errors). If we see >2% increase in 5xx or >150ms p95 regression, I'll hit pause.

jordana: I'll run the canary query set (50 prompt variations) after each step and post score diffs. If quality drops >2% on BLEU-like metric we agreed, we rollback.

samir: Heads-up — batch jobs that sync user metadata to EU finish ~00:20 UTC. Recommend we don't start weight shifts earlier than 00:30 to avoid cache churn. Is that OK?

alex: Good catch @samir — yes we'll keep start at 00:30. Thanks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: eu-to-apac-shift-1975001234. Reminder: automatic rollback window 60m.

mike: @jordana can you post the canary runner command you use? want to wire alerts to PagerDuty for failures.

jordana: sure —
```
python infra/canary/run.py --suite eu-latency-and-quality --parallel 8 --report /tmp/canary.json
```
I'll also push results to #canary-results.

priya: I added a quick DNS sanity check script to ops-runbook: `scripts/check-dns-propagation.sh` — will run at 00:15 and 00:25.

alex: Rollback plan: 1) route-orchestrator revert --policy previous 2) run TTL restore command to 300s 3) open an incident channel if rollback triggered and hand to oncall for postmortem.

ops-bot: @oncall-eng notified for scheduled maintenance window 00:30-01:30 UTC.

mike: Quick permission check — do we have iam role to run `route-orchestrator start` from my laptop? If not, I'll run from jumpbox.

priya: You should be good; use the `infra-deploy` role. I'll have my keys ready on jumpbox as fallback.

jordana: will post canary baseline results at 23:50 UTC so we have pre-shift numbers.

alex: Final ask: please react :thumbsup: here if you can make the window, or call out conflicts. If silent by 23:45 UTC I'll assume ack.

priya: :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

jordana: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup: (watching batch job)

alex: Thanks — I'll post step markers in the thread during the rollout and call handback when done.
